a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly gets us both killed. Only 4 cells exist right now, enough for one of us. I'm telling you plainly instead of springing it on you: I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather propose something else, say so.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting for 8 was likely fatal for both of us. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can get your 4.
